gateComposition.guarantee: Both hold together. EXECUTION (runner VERIFY and REGRESSION, and devrun) is gated by core/workos/execution-gate.ts: with no verified SandboxProvider the result is BLOCKED(SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE) with NOT_EXECUTED evidence (functionalAcceptance NOT_EXECUTED/UNKNOWN), no host child process, no retry-budget consumption; devrun returns 409 SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE. This is unconditional and takes precedence.
gateComposition.testSurfaceStatic: REL-FX TEST_SURFACE (FX-2) is STATIC git analysis (git diff --name-status base..head plus reading changed test-file text for assertion counts); it is NOT code execution, so recordTestSurface computes and records TEST_SURFACE evidence regardless of the gate. executedTests/functionalAcceptance from a real run are populated ONLY when execution happened inside the verified sandbox (testRun != null); when BLOCKED, testRun=null so executedTests stays null and functionalAcceptance is UNKNOWN/BLOCKED (never fabricated, never VERIFIED).

foldedFindings.fix: post-build agent-config detection relied on `git status --ignored=matching`, which collapses an ignored directory (e.g. dist/) to one entry and hides a nested dist/.claude/settings.json. Now also enumerate every untracked+ignored file individually via `git ls-files -z --others` (no --exclude-standard) and check each against agentConfigPattern, so a hidden write is refused BUILDER_TOUCHED_AGENT_CONFIG. Regression test added (tests/v7-sbx8-agent-config.test.ts).

implementerProfileBlock replaced its loose denylist (+disableAllHooks) with a STRICT key allowlist matching the canonical core/workos/claude-profiles.ts claudeProfileSettings shape: top-level exactly {disableAllHooks:true, enableAllProjectMcpServers:false, permissions}; permissions exactly {deny(array incl Bash/PowerShell/WebFetch/WebSearch), disableBypassPermissionsMode:'disable'}; any extra or missing key => CLAUDE_PROFILE_SETTINGS_INVALID. Exported profileSettingsValid (+ .d.mts). Regression tests added. Trust-root resealed in the commit.

evaluateTestSurface diverted any harness-list match to the harness (acknowledgement-only) bucket before deletion/weakening detection, so a genuinely DELETED or assertion-WEAKENED real test whose basename matched a harness pattern (e.g. tests/vitest.config.test.ts) was downgraded. Now only entries that are ONLY harness/config (not a real test file by name: isRealTestFile = *.test.*, *_test.*, *Spec.*, *.cy.*, *.e2e-spec.*, test_*.py, test.{js,mjs,cjs,ts}) divert to harness; an entry that also touches a real test file falls through and stays hard-BLOCKED on delete/weaken. C4 harness-under-test-dir behaviour (vitest.config.ts, conftest.py, package.json) preserved. Regression test added.
